The proposal policy (unit fixture faults labelled as such; separate live cases query pinned OPA with allow/deny, a real refused TCP connection, an installed new bundle revision and an installed non-boolean result), deadline, audit availability, proposal integrity and the source eligibility are checked at proposal and again at consumption: revocation, correction, expiry, stop-epoch change (also during policy I/O), policy change, deadline, unrecorded, tampered or foreign proposals fail closed with an audited denial and no proposal; on the real backends revocation, supersession, foreign compartment, stop and policy denial leave only the denial and an unchanged ledger

on real PostgreSQL (metadata, encrypted content, full-text, representation records/descriptors), Qdrant (native and parallel vector layouts) and OpenBao transit: a model upgrade (pinned v1 fixture hash -> pinned v2 feature hashing) builds a parallel representation version of every current ACTIVE vector-bearing version, searched only under its own pin (VECTOR and HYBRID) while the native v1 representation answers byte-identically; every byte of metadata, content, lexical tables, native vectors and head pointers is unchanged; the manifest, descriptors and stored binary32 vectors are identical across repeated rebuilds, fresh adapters and a fresh world with reversed admission order

a Qdrant outage mid-rebuild, a failing audit sink, an acknowledged-but-unwritten index or descriptor write, an unavailable, non-deterministic or drifting model leave the representation BUILDING: retrieval of that version fails closed (REPRESENTATION_REBUILDING) while the native representation is unaffected; resuming converges to the clean manifest; concurrent rebuilds serialise through a compare-and-set record and converge

On the real 0056 backup drill (PostgreSQL snapshot copy, Qdrant snapshot recovery, OpenBao attestation) restored memory stays closed until the manifest is authenticated, bound to the recovery point and not newer than the deletion authority, every tombstone is replayed through the 0056 gate and the restored projection equals the manifest; a deletion after the backup is never resurrected, a held item stays held, an unauthenticated or foreign manifest purges nothing, a stale deletion epoch is refused before any purge, projection drift (older restored version, extra item, drift during materialisation) and a missing journal keep or close the boundary

VF-001/VF-002: trusted verified GCS and live stop epoch on restore open/reconcile and around materialisation; unavailable, invalid or changed epoch closes the gate and audits denial; stable nonzero epoch permits unchanged results. Inventory rechecks the complete committed-head map, detects new/missing/reclassified heads and version changes, while PENDING and historical rows do not create phantom usage. Unit controls and live PostgreSQL/Qdrant/OpenBao positive/negative restore and partition races; authority fixtures remain explicit test ports.
